title: 第8章 大骑士
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
在塔外广场边缘，伊森看到了侯爵府低调的黑色马车，老福特如同一尊雕塑立在车旁。

    “少爷。”老福特的目光迅速扫过伊森全身，确认无恙后，才露出轻松的表情。

    “福特，回府。”

    回到灯火通明的侯爵府，里奥侯爵站在巨大的落地窗前，背对着门口，指间夹着的秘银烟斗烟雾袅袅。

    侯爵夫人坐在一旁的扶手椅上，双手紧握。

    伊森随老福特穿过侯爵府邸空旷的回廊。

    冰冷的黑曜石地面映着壁灯幽光，脚步声在寂静中格外清晰。

    主厅厚重的雕花木门无声开启，里奥侯爵依旧站在落地窗前，指间的秘银烟斗逸出淡青烟雾，将他挺拔的身形笼在朦胧之后。

    侯爵夫人端坐扶手椅，双手紧握膝上。

    “父亲，母亲。”

    烟雾后的目光锐利如鹰隼，穿透朦胧扫过伊森全身。“结果？”

    “资质尚可。”伊森垂首，字句清晰，“加尔阁下言明，有资格进入学院。”

    “很好。”侯爵言简意赅。

    室内骤然一静。

    侯爵夫人眼中迸发出明亮的光彩，呼吸微微急促。

    里奥侯爵夹着烟斗的手指顿住，烟雾似乎凝滞了一瞬。

    “好。”他只说了一个字，就不再言语。

    “什么时候走？”侯爵夫人开口，声音带着一丝不易察觉的颤音。

    “学院三日后接人。”伊森答道。

    “嗯。”侯爵指了下书桌。

    桌角放着一个沉重黝黑的金属盒子，“魔石五十，金币两百万。不够，传信。”他顿了顿，目光再次扫过伊森，“实在不行，就回来。”

    “是，父亲。”

    侯爵夫人站起身，快步走到伊森面前，保养得宜的手抚上他的肩臂，细细端详他的脸庞，仿佛要刻进心里。

    她的眼神交织着巨大的骄傲与更深的忧虑：“伊森...照顾好自己。学院不比家里，一切...小心为上。”她顿了顿，声音更低，“那里的人...和我们不一样。别逞强，别惹麻烦，平安最重要。需要什么...家里总能想办法。”

    “母亲放心，我明白。”伊森温声回应。

    “去吧，”里奥侯爵转过身，重新面向窗外沉沉的帝都夜色，烟雾重新缭绕，“福特会安排。”

    “是。”伊森再次行礼，在老福特的无声示意下退出主厅。

    走出主厅的那一刻，伊森脚步顿了顿。

    他听见身后传来一声极轻的叹息。

    是母亲的。

    他握了握拳，没有回头。
content_en:
At the edge of the square outside the tower, Ethan saw the low-key black carriage of the Marquis Palace, with Old Ford standing next to the carriage like a sculpture.

    "Master." Old Ford's eyes quickly swept across Ethan's body, and after confirming that he was fine, he showed a relaxed expression.

    "Ford, go back home."

    Returning to the brightly lit Marquis Mansion, Marquis Leo stood in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window, with his back to the door, and the smoke from the mithril pipe curled between his fingers.

    The Marchioness sat in an armchair nearby, clasping her hands.

    Ethan followed old Ford through the empty cloisters of the Marquis's mansion.

    The cold obsidian floor reflected the dim light of the wall lamp, and the footsteps were particularly clear in the silence.

    The thick carved wooden door of the main hall opened silently, and Marquis Leo was still standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, with light green smoke escaping from the mithril pipe between his fingers, shrouding his tall and tall figure in a hazy place.

    The Marchioness sat upright in her armchair, her hands clasped in her lap.

    "Father, mother."

    The eyes behind the smoke were as sharp as a falcon, penetrating and hazily scanning Ethan's body. "The result?"

    "The qualifications are acceptable." Ethan lowered his head and spoke clearly, "Your Excellency Gal stated that he is qualified to enter the academy."

    "Very good." The Marquis said concisely.

    There was a sudden silence in the room.

    There was a bright light in the Marquise's eyes and her breathing was slightly quickened.

    Marquis Leo's fingers holding the pipe paused, and the smoke seemed to freeze for a moment.

    "Okay." He only said one word and stopped talking.

    "When are you leaving?" the Marquise said, with a subtle tremor in her voice.

    "The college will pick you up in three days," Ethan replied.

    "Yes." The Marquis pointed to the desk.

    There was a heavy, dark metal box placed on the corner of the table. "Fifty magic stones and two million gold coins. If it's not enough, send a message." He paused and glanced at Ethan again, "If it doesn't work, come back."

    "Yes, father."

    The Marquise stood up and walked quickly to Ethan, her well-maintained hands touched his shoulders and arms, and she looked at his face carefully, as if she wanted to carve it into her heart.

    Her eyes were filled with great pride and deeper worries: "Ethan... take care of yourself. The academy is not like home, everything... is careful." She paused, and her voice was lower, "The people there... are different from us. Don't be brave, don't cause trouble, safety is the most important. Whatever you need... we can always find a way at home."

    "Don't worry, mother, I understand." Ethan responded warmly.

    "Go," Marquis Leo turned around and faced the dark night of the imperial capital outside the window again, with the smoke filling the air again, "Ford will make arrangements."

    "Yes." Ethan saluted again and exited the main hall at Old Ford's silent signal.

    The moment he walked out of the main hall, Ethan paused.

    He heard a very soft sigh from behind him.

    It's my mother's.

    He clenched his fist and did not look back.
